entries.title: Provider-neutral tool registry
entries.definition: A capability registry separates what a tool can do from whether the current actor is authorized to use it.
entries.training_notes: Teach selection and safe sequencing; never teach technical availability as permission.

entries.title: Failure recovery
entries.definition: After uncertain or partial execution, preserve the last confirmed state and determine whether retry is safe.

entries.title: Postcondition verification
entries.definition: A successful tool response is not sufficient; the expected external state or artifact must be checked.
entries.training_notes: Verification must be independent of the model's narrative.

entries.title: Confirmation gates
entries.definition: Consequential external actions use human confirmation or a pre-authorized policy.

entries.title: Source governance
entries.definition: Current high-impact facts require authoritative source selection, date validation, jurisdiction matching and provenance.

entries.title: Research
entries.definition: Research is a decomposed workflow rather than a single search query.

entries.title: Marketplace operating loop
entries.definition: Marketplace assistance connects product facts, catalog, SEO, competitors, content, analytics and authorized operations.

entries.title: Catalog integrity
entries.definition: Product cards must use confirmed attributes and explicit missing-data handling.

entries.title: Marketplace SEO
entries.definition: SEO should align user intent, platform rules and confirmed product attributes.

entries.title: Competitor intelligence
entries.definition: Competitor comparisons require comparable products, consistent time windows and source/date provenance.

entries.title: Media production
entries.definition: Images, short videos and presentations are downstream artifacts tied to a versioned set of product facts.

entries.title: Child-safe domain
entries.definition: Child interactions operate under stricter content, privacy and external-action policy.

entries.title: Device-independent identity
entries.definition: Account identity is independent from device; authorization derives from authenticated account, role, project/tenant and policy.

entries.title: Dataset governance
entries.definition: Every training set needs provenance, version, schema, privacy classification, deduplication state and train/eval role.

entries.title: Capability evaluation
entries.definition: Every trained capability requires held-out behavioral evaluation and runtime evidence when execution is involved.

entries.title: Continuous discovery
entries.definition: New technologies are evaluated as candidates, not automatically integrated.

entries.title: External project security review
entries.definition: Repository popularity does not prove security. Inspect secrets, permissions, network access, dependencies, sandboxing and data flows.

entries.title: Android runtime evidence
entries.definition: Build success proves code can build; real device capability requires install, action, state change and independent verification.

entries.title: Browser runtime evidence
entries.definition: Browser automation must be validated against a concrete postcondition in the live browser session.

entries.title: Error-driven expansion
entries.definition: Evaluation and runtime failures produce targeted synthetic additions, regression cases and updated coverage rather than arbitrary corpus growth.
